title: Intermediate Backend Engineer , Security Factory
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025.  An overview of this role
 As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on GitLab's Security Factory: Code Scanning team, you'll help developers find and fix security issues in their code by contributing to the static analysis engine that finds them.
 Your work spans both the engine and the tools we use to evaluate it. You'll extend how the engine models programs, from parsing source code and resolving symbols to building call graphs and tracking tainted data across files and languages. title: Quality Lead, Gen AI
location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
description:
The quality of data underpins Generative AI programs. At Scale, Quality Control is responsible for ensuring data we deliver to the world’s leading AI customers is state of the art.
 As a Quality Control Lead, you’ll own that call for some of our highest-impact Generative AI programs. You'll lead a large team of quality control specialists to measure and improve quality across these programs, from multilingual post-training data to agentic RL environments. You will work on frontier-level problems – the programs you work on train the models people are talking about.
 You will hold delivery teams accountable across our highest-impact projects – helping solve nuanced quality issues, as well as leading strategic initiatives to enable reliable, scalable operations across the organization.
 What you’ll do
 Lead and grow a team of quality specialists - hire, coach and calibrate this team of specialists.
 Turn unclear customer requirements into clear standards - work with delivery teams to interpret and improve customer requirements, and then turn that into measurable signals of data quality.
 Run the quality system. Own the daily operation: plan and allocate workforce capacity, produce quality reporting, measure productivity and efficiency, and drive quality control policies.
 Analyzing quality trends. Identify, root-cause, and elevate defect patterns that delivery teams can take action on.
 Build the future of QC. Our team already leverages agentic capabilities, but you will help decide and lead what gets built next to continue to scale and optimize our quality operations.
 Ideally you’d have
 A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Operations, or a related field.
 3+ years leading teams or scaling large operational/technical processes.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills (particularly in SQL) with attention to detail.
 Experience building systems, processes, and teams across multiple customer segments or product lines.

title: Growth Marketing Manager, Lifecycle
description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
 The Lifecycle Growth Marketing team engages with millions of Lyft riders and drivers to drive preference and usage of Lyft. The team runs hundreds of acquisition, engagement, retention and resurrection experiments every year across email, push notifications, SMS and in-app messaging surfaces.
 We are data-driven in everything we do. We test and measure all of our communications and tailor experiences to be personalized and contextual by audience segment.
 In this role, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, and Marketing Operations to design, test and optimize incentive and non-incentive messages and experiences.
 Responsibilities:
 Own the lifecycle marketing strategy for your audience — define the channel mix, set the prioritization framework, and ensure every communication delivers clear value to the target user
 Build and manage an experimentation program that drives measurable impact — from ideation through results, with a clear point of view on what to test
 Partner with Engineering, Product, and Data Science to unlock new platform capabilities, influence roadmaps, and push beyond out-of-the-box tooling
 Own performance reporting — define metrics, experimentation setup, and share results and next steps with stakeholders and leadership
 Drive creative strategy — brief, review, and iterate on assets across email, push, SMS and in-app with a strong feedback loop with designers and copywriters
 Apply behavioral science frameworks to inform message sequencing, timing, and incentive design

 6+ years in growth marketing. You've owned a full lifecycle marketing program from the ground up — not just executing campaigns, but building strategy from high-level goals and managing a prioritized roadmap

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
description:
About the role
 Scale's Global Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer, you'll own the AI behaviour of production systems our clients depend on, including the agents, evaluations, and backend integration behind them. You'll lead delivery for your workstream and act as the technical point of contact for clients on how their AI performs on live data.
 What you'll do
 Own the AI layer of production systems for public sector clients, including agents, model integration, and the backend services they run on
 Build production agents from established architectural patterns, with reliable tool calling, guardrails, and observability
 Select and adapt established evaluation methods, and design new evaluations for client-specific risks
 Apply context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, model adaptation, or inference optimisation
 Investigate regressions in the systems you own, lead root-cause analysis, and implement preventative changes
 Lead project planning for your workstream and manage client expectations on scope, risk, and delivery
 Codify recurring client work into reusable tooling, evaluation components, or guidance that other engineers adopt
 Mentor engineers through code review, pairing, and delegated ownership
 What we look for
 Backend engineering experience, with a track record of taking AI/ML systems into production and keeping them reliable
 Ownership of the AI behaviour of a production system end to end, rather than delivering a component scoped by another team
 Hands-on evaluation design that ties model behaviour to real-world outcomes, used to catch regressions
 Comfort working directly with clients, including explaining model behaviour and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders
 Practical knowledge of handling regulated or sensitive data and designing for auditability; sovereign or on-premise deployment experience is valuable

title: Chief Customer Officer
description:
Work from anywhere, impact everywhere
 Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
We're a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.
 Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.
To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.
We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.
We are committed to changing the way things are done.
 Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position
 Work from anywhere!
 Position overview
 Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship.
 Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible.
 The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision.
